text:
Iris (CS Ops): small project request: Enablement should POST a compact completion webhook so CS can auto-log activity, queue follow-ups, and optionally adjust healthscore based on curriculum + NPS.
Jason (Eng Backend): yep. prefer a single endpoint on ops-api: /webhooks/enablement/completed. signed + idempotent.
Iris (CS Ops): fields we need: account_id, contact_id, completion_id, training_key, delivery_mode, nps (optional), feedback (optional), event_ts. also include opt_out_reason when present.
Leela (Product): product asks for curriculum_tag and curriculum_version so we can run cohort comparisons. also an optional recommended_health_delta (decimal) if Enablement can compute it.
Tom (CS Manager): gating: always tag enablement.received. apply health delta after 14 days unless negative signals (billing_issue, downgrade) appear. if nps <=7 auto-schedule renewal_playbook_low_nps. if nps >=9 tag advocate and consider +8 after gate.
Jason (Eng Backend): security: X-RW-Signature HMAC, X-RW-Idempotency header. idempotency key = sha256(account_id + completion_id). retry policy 3x with exponential backoff. support signature rotation header X-RW-Signature-V2 during rollout.
Iris (CS Ops): when received create CRM activity "Enablement: completion" with note = feedback + training_key + instructor if present. if opt_out_reason in [privacy,legal] only write internal audit entry, do not sync externally.
Jason (Eng Backend): sample payload below:
```
POST /webhooks/enablement/completed
Headers: X-RW-Signature: sha256=..., X-RW-Idempotency: <id>
{
  "account_id": "acct_9b7f",
  "contact_id": "c_1122",
  "completion_id": "comp_20260321_01",
  "training_key": "platform-core-live",
  "delivery_mode": "instructor_led",
  "curriculum_tag": "onboarding_core",
  "curriculum_version": "v1.2",
  "nps": 10,
  "feedback": "Great walkthrough, immediate wins!",
  "event_ts": "2026-03-21T19:00:00Z"
}
```
Leela (Product): add instructor_id and duration_minutes if available. we'll use curriculum_tag to produce a per-curriculum baseline for health deltas.
Tom (CS Manager): backfill needed for 90 days. export CSV with account_id, owner_email, received_ts, nps, opt_out_reason, recommended_action so CS can triage.
Jason (Eng Backend): will add admin backfill endpoint `/admin/backfill/enablement?days=90&dry_run=true` that honors idempotency and includes owner mapping in CSV. will also add feature-flag ff.enable_enablement_health to try immediate scoring for canary org 123999.
Iris (CS Ops): audit: every webhook should generate an audit record with meta.source=enablement, meta.idempotency_key, raw_payload_ref. pls include a small sha256 sample in PR so ops can verify locally.
Jason (Eng Backend): timeline: PR by Fri EOD, dry-run backfill Sat, canary next Wed for 7-day metrics watch, then full rollout. will include HMAC verification snippet and test payloads in PR. ops-bot: created ticket CS-4120 assigned to Jason.
Tom (CS Manager): include renewal_risk delta metric in dashboard and NPS histogram by curriculum_tag.
Iris (CS Ops): I'll compile owner list + opt-out exceptions and post here. tag me when PR is up. :thumbsup:
